header: A week you can publish with one hand on the counter
bodytext:
The planner opens on last week, because that is what most weeks are. Copy it forward, move the three shifts that changed, and the checks run as you go: rest periods, contract hours, the trainee who may not close alone. Nothing is validated at the end, when it is too late to do anything about it.

Publishing sends the week to every phone at once and logs who saw it. From then on, a change is a change, with the old time and the new one shown side by side.
caption: The week planner with the budget line at the bottom of the screen.

points.title: Copy last week forward
points.text: Two clicks, then only the exceptions need touching.

points.title: Checks while you plan
points.text: A breach is refused at the shift, not reported on Monday.

points.title: One published version
points.text: Every later change carries the old time next to the new one.
